messages:
Alex: quick note: int8 canary (harbor-lite) produced duplicated func_call invocations when streaming=true. saw same request id trigger two /tools/annotate POSTs.

Jin: can you paste raw stream chunks?

Alex: snippet:
chunk1: {"type":"function_call","name":"annotate","args":"{\"text\":\"x\"" , partial:true}
chunk2: {"type":"function_call","name":"annotate","args":"{\"text\":\"x\"}

Sasha: fp16 baseline had no duplicates?

Alex: correct. int8 changes chunk boundaries.

canary-bot: Canary 1756000000: model=harbor-lite-int8, stream_mode=chunked, streaming_hold=false

Jin: hypothesis: client retries on truncated args and then server finishes original emit => duplicate execution.

Sasha: short fixes: pause streaming canaries for int8, enable streaming_hold=true for int8, add call_id in args and client buffer heuristic (200ms) before retry.

Alex: agreed. Jin please run 200-run bench comparing dup_rate fp16 vs int8 and upload results.

canary-bot: Paused streaming canaries for harbor-lite-int8. Notified owners.
